Thomas Paine, The Age of Reason, edited by Moncure Daniel Conway.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-paine/the-age-of-reason

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Paine (annotator, author), died 1809.
- Moncure Daniel Conway (annotator, editor, writer of introduction), died 1907.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'The Age of Reason was published in 1794 and 1807 by Thomas Paine. Threadable sponsored the production of this ebook for Standard Ebooks. It was produced by Alex Cabal, and is based on a transcription produced in 2003 by Norman M. Wolcott and David Widger for Project Gutenberg and on digital scans from Google Books. The cover page is adapted from Monastery Graveyard in the Snow, a painting completed in 1819 by Caspar David Friedrich. The cover and title pages feature the League Spartan and Sorts Mill Goudy typefaces created in 2014 and 2009 by The League of Moveable Type. The first edition of this ebook was released on April 29, 2021, 7:14 p.m. You can check for updates to this ebook, view its revision history, or download it for different ereading systems at standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-paine/the-age-of-reason. The volunteer-driven Standard Ebooks project relies on readers like you to submit typos, corrections, and other improvements. Anyone can contribute at standardebooks.org.').

- Country of origin: does not matter, because every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die died in 1907.
